gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Editorial swagger, gently shaded: Quilon swells and thins its strokes across tall, open letters. And Noto Sans Phoenician takes the quieter job, letting its s curves open wide at both ends in a generous lowercase.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahla: Quilon: commanding, editorial, horizontals a notch lighter than its uprights. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi then settles into text with gaping e mouths and barely rising capitals, so a full page moves along approachably.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Sharp and editorial, Quilon keeps thin strokes at a respectable weight. Noto Sans Rejang then reads with wide, porthole-like counters, so lines of text feel open and unhurried from start to finish.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Approachable Noto Sans Samaritan lets daylight into its curves, beneath a Quilon heading whose arch shoulders thin slowly into lighter joins. Make Quilon small and that slow thinning goes unnoticed.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Quiet authority: Quilon shades its strokes lightly, with no harsh thin spots anywhere. And Noto Sans Saurashtra adds counters that stay open to the outside, which is where this pairing really wins.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-sc: Quilon brings medium-contrast strokes and a commanding, editorial tone to the top. Noto Sans SC follows with chalky curves that stop short of closing, so text moves along lightly.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Curves with the slight thickening of a reed pen give Quilon its editorial edge. Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase, so a page of text feels dense and steady.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads big and open, with a sizable x-height, plus curved letters whose mouths stay wide. Quilon supplies the drama through stroke contrast; the body simply carries the words.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Quilon arrives with commanding, editorial presence, its curves carrying only modest stress. Noto Sans Sundanese backs it with open-mouthed e crossbars and capitals barely taller than the lowercase.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Clean, editorial and quietly commanding, Quilon eases the reading pace with mild shifts in stroke weight across its curves. Noto Sans Sunuwar then lets daylight through every curve beneath it.
